text:
maria: Kicking off the scheduled deploy for llm-route-v3 now. Plan: 0->10% for 15m, 10->50% for 30m if telemetry looks good, then full. Pinning current model version on canary group before ramp.

kai: Ack. I'll watch latency P50/P95 + error-rate. If P95 > 250ms or errors +2% over baseline we hold and roll back.

maria: Deploybot will manage the FF ramp. Backstop rule: auto-hold if error_rate_delta >= 2.0 or request_time_p95 >= 250ms for 5m.

deploybot: [bot] Received command: /flag-ramp --flag=llmroute_v3 --to=10 --duration=15m --backstop="error_rate_delta>=2.0||p95>=250"

deploybot: [bot] Flag llmroute_v3 set to 10% (cohorts: default -> canary). Started 15m watch window.

rahul: Noted. If we hit hold, what's the rollback playbook? Quick rollback should unpin and set flag to 0% and roll canary back to model v2. Sample: `./ops rollback --service=llm-router --to-version=v2`

ops-lead: +1 on rollback cmd. Also, add a manual holdpoint at 10->50 transition so on-call can review metrics before wider roll. Can we make the transition gated?

maria: Yes — adding manual gate. Transition will require an explicit `approve-ramp` from release lead. Automations still apply for emergency auto-hold.

kai: Sending the quick-check dashboard link in thread: https://dash.redwood.internal/boards/llmroute-v3?range=15m  (watch p95, error%, cpu-util)

jen: Release notes posted: https://confluence.redwood.com/llmroute/v3-release-notes — includes known changes, model diff, and behavior tests. Tagging oncall. @ops-lead @rahul

ops-lead: Got it. I'll be on standby for the manual gate at ~10:20 UTC. If anything spikes we abort and follow rahul's rollback steps. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [bot] Watch window ended. Metrics stable (p95=180ms, error_rate_delta=0.4%). Ready for manual approval to move to 50%.

maria: Manual gate: @ops-lead please `approve-ramp` when ready.

ops-lead: Approved. Proceed to 50%.

deploybot: [bot] Flag llmroute_v3 ramping to 50% as approved. Command: /flag-ramp --flag=llmroute_v3 --to=50 --duration=30m --manual-approval=true

kai: Monitoring. Will call if we need to pause.

maria: Thanks team — will update this thread if we hit any backstops or finish full cutover.
